provenance.implementation_boundary: the record's nine classical microstructure measures, stability selection and purged walk-forward gradient boosting adapted to the complete local Binance USD-M symbol x timeframe eligible universe; the source's minute-level spot-plus-perpetual venue pair is not reproduced (the canonical raw carries USD-M perpetual klines only), the hierarchical/SHAP/meta-learning layers are not reproduced, and no source-reported result is claimed

universe.source_universe: 6 major cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, and 4 others) on Binance spot and perpetual futures; minute-level OHLCV; >3 million minute observations
universe.portability: direct (record: 'this study is conducted entirely on cryptocurrency markets')
universe.selection: complete local eligible universe (every canonical raw symbol x every available kline interval of the registered data window); no symbol or timeframe drop, no post-hoc shrink

data.venue: Binance USD-M perpetual canonical raw archive
data.point_in_time: canonical raw snapshot; no bar after the registered end; every rolling feature is a function of bars at or before the signal bar
data.missing_data: fail closed on non-contiguous bars at every registered frequency; no gap fill; no resampling

signal_registration.mechanism: classical microstructure features predict short-term returns; the standardised forecast sign is the episode entry, and the registered DCA execution rail decides every fill
signal_registration.feature_derivation: research-defined local implementation: the nine registered measures are computed from the canonical OHLCV fields only (no order-book or trade-tape input), over the causal rolling window of one registered day (window = max(8, bars_per_day))
signal_registration.target: next registered bar log return y_t = ln(C_{t+1} / C_t)
signal_registration.pipeline: purged walk-forward: 12-month train / 3-month test / 3-month step, one purged bar; bootstrap stability selection (20 resamples, top-6 by |Spearman|, frequency >= 0.60) on the TRAIN segment only; tabular gradient boosting (LightGBM and scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingRegressor) fitted on the TRAIN segment only
signal_registration.position_mapping: z = forecast / in-sample TRAIN forecast sigma; |z| >= 0.5 emits a fresh non-zero episode event (long_only: +1; long_short: +1 and -1); a repeated same-sign bar emits nothing
signal_registration.formation: each registered timeframe close; execution at the next registered bar open
signal_registration.causality: no feature, selection, normalisation or model fit reads a bar after the decision timestamp; the selector and the OOS/full/stress readers never read the test segment

parameter_domain.direction_provenance: the record registers no actionable signal direction, so both sign readings of its forecast are measured as separate pre-registered cases; no unregistered third leg is added
parameter_domain.selection_rule: historical-only selector: episodes floor, net_pnl > 0, Sharpe > 0, then OOS/full/four stress grids and the legal DCA neighbourhood; the winner's strategy and DCA parameters travel together, frozen before OOS is read

user_fixed_invariants: tranche #12 is reserve/buffer, routine active levels max 11
same-bar multi-level crossing deterministic conservative ordering

falsification: cross-coin transfer reader (train on one coin, predict every coin)
naive-forecaster benchmark (momentum sign, always-long) on the same target
cost-attrition grid (8x registered fee) against the record's no-strategy-survives-fees finding
robustness_plan.baseline: the two registered model implementations and both sign readings are disclosed as separate pre-registered cases; no post-hoc gate uses them

split.rule: chronological; frozen model fit prefix-only; OOS is read-only

costs.slippage_basis: instrument price_increment, adverse on both legs
costs.funding: canonical raw settlements charged to the containing bar, cost-only, actual per-episode funding

registered_family_level_falsification.note: The record's own falsification battery is measured and disclosed; it never shrinks the local eligible universe and is never converted into a silent PASS gate.
items: lower fee tiers (institutional/market-maker) - not testable on the canonical raw, which carries the retail taker fee only; the registered stress grids move costs upward
different feature sets or model architectures - measured as the two registered tabular gradient-boosting cases over the registered feature panel
cross-coin transfer failure - measured by the cross-asset transfer reader
cross-venue (spot vs perpetual) transfer - not testable: the canonical raw holds no spot venue

row_match_recipe.equality: exact, numeric == float compare; labels bytewise
